newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei falls below 20,000 in morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei falls below 20,000 in morning trade.

text.p: The Tokyo stock market's key Nikkei average slipped below the 20,000 level in the Tuesday morning session, the first time the index has been below 20,000 since March 15 when the benchmark hit 19,960.14.
As of 0029 GMT, the 225-share Nikkei average was down 135.45 points or 0.67 percent at 19,971.66. Its September futures were also down 170 points at 19,980.
Brokers said the September futures started off feebly, providing the cash Nikkei with the push it needed to fall past the 20,000 level.

But they said the Nikkei average had been under pressure since Monday by a grim outlook on the domestic economy as well as weakness in the Dow industrials on Wall Street late last week. On Monday, it fell as low as 20,082.19 but was supported by investors buying on dips.
